mapper.insert: insert into collection (user_id, anime_id, list_type, progress, favorite) values (#{userId}, #{animeId}, #{listType}, #{progress}, #{favorite})
mapper.select: select c.id, c.user_id, c.anime_id, c.list_type, c.progress, c.favorite, c.created_at, c.updated_at, a.title, a.cover from collection c left join anime a on c.anime_id = a.id where c.anime_id = #{animeId} and c.user_id = #{userId}
